title: Perform ADA diabetes screening tests
description: Review age, BMI, pregnancy status, and diabetes risk factors to decide whether screening should be performed.

action.description: Order or review fasting plasma glucose, A1C, OGTT, or random glucose with symptoms as clinically appropriate.

documentation.citation: Adults of any age with overweight or obesity and one or more additional risk factors should be considered for testing.
